entities.name: Max von Stephanitz

entities.summary: Max Emil Friedrich von Stephanitz was a German cavalry officer and dog breeder. He is credited with having developed the German Shepherd Dog breed as it is currently known, set guidelines for the breed standard, and was the first president of the Verein für Deutsche Schäferhunde (S.V.).
